item.title: R. Kelly Asks Trump Administration for Prison Release in Official Clemency Petition
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we keep you up to date on the latest news. Today, we're talking about R. Kelly, the disgraced R&B singer who's serving a decades-long prison sentence for sex crimes. It's been reported that Kelly's legal team is now lobbying President Donald Trump for clemency.
[Short music transition]
Host: According to case filings, Kelly has a pending petition for commutation of his 31-year prison sentence. If granted, this would wipe out his sentence, but leave his conviction intact. The petition was submitted sometime in 2026, but the exact details are still unclear.
[Short music transition]
Host: Kelly's lawyer, Beau Brindley, has been publicly appealing to Trump for relief, saying that the President is the only one with the power and courage to set Kelly free. Interestingly, Trump has a history of granting pardons and commutations unilaterally, based on lobbying within his inner circle.
[Short music transition]
Host: Meanwhile, Brindley is also pursuing a new trial in Chicago, arguing that jailhouse officials were trying to kill Kelly. However, a judge has already rejected his calls for immediate release.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's the latest on R. Kelly's efforts to secure clemency. We'll keep you updated as more information becomes available. Thanks for listening!
